title: Enkesønnen
world: Present-day inland Norway: spruce forest, bogs, a national road and the odd petrol station. The Stranger's house lies at the end of a long gravel road, behind spruce so tall and dense that it is dusk at noon: a big old wooden house, half renovated, with new windows in one wing, plastic sheeting over the other, and paint buckets and ladders along a hallway that ends in four doors set close together. Behind the doors wait a whip braided from wild-rose twigs with thorns as long as drawing pins, a boulder the size of a loaf and an old tin army canteen, a trapdoor over a huge copper cauldron that boils with no heat under it, and a stable built inside the house. The ointment is grey and cold, in a small blue clay jar. A huge hollow linden stands in a green forest clearing near the royal estate.
palette: Damp, overcast late summer in the inland forests: deep blue-green spruce, rust-red and ochre bog, wild roses and red rosehips, silver drizzle and low, cool golden sunrises. Inside the Stranger's house: flat grey light through plastic sheeting and the warm glow of copper. The royal estate is cool glass, pale stone, clipped green hedges and black cars. Accents: wild-rose pink, rust orange and crisp white.

cast.name: Enkesønnen
cast.description: En fattig, sta ung mann med skulderveske som overlever trollets fire forbudte dører, går i lavparykk som foraktet gartnergutt og rir i hemmelighet til krigen i rusten rustning.
cast.look: A slim, kind-faced young man of about nineteen with milk-pale skin and bright red cheeks, an oval face, a neat, narrow nose, big dark-brown eyes under thick level black eyebrows and short, glossy blue-black hair, wavy on top, with a stubborn cowlick sticking up at the crown. He wears a faded cornflower-blue quilted vest over an oatmeal hoodie, worn dark-grey jeans and scuffed brown boots, with a small, battered red canvas shoulder bag slung across his chest.
cast.portrait: Background: a national road running into dark spruce forest.

cast.name: Gartnergutten med lavparykken
cast.description: Enkesønnen i forkledning. Med en pjuskete parykk av grå granlav ser han ut som en som har overvintret i en grøft, og ingen på kongsgården kjenner ham igjen.
cast.look: A slim young man of about nineteen with milk-pale skin, bright red cheeks, an oval face, a neat, narrow nose, big dark-brown eyes and thick level black eyebrows, whose hair is completely hidden under a huge, shaggy wig of pale grey-green beard lichen that hangs in long, wispy, tangled strands over his ears, neck and forehead, so he looks wretched and scruffy, as if he had wintered in a ditch. He wears a grubby, faded cornflower-blue quilted vest over a torn oatmeal hoodie, mud-stained dark-grey jeans and scuffed brown boots.
cast.portrait: Background: the tall round glass summerhouse on its posts.

cast.name: Den fremmede rytteren
cast.description: Enkesønnen i den mest rustne rustningen fra trollets hus. Han rir til krigen på den svarte hesten når kongen er i knipe, og ingen vet hvem han er.
cast.look: A slim young man of about nineteen with milk-pale skin, bright red cheeks, an oval face, a neat, narrow nose, big dark-brown eyes under thick level black eyebrows and a lock of glossy blue-black hair on his forehead, clad in an antique suit of plate armour blotched all over with orange-brown rust: a dented breastplate, jointed rusty arm and leg plates, a rusty mail collar and a round rusty helmet with the visor pushed up. A sword with a rust-spotted blade hangs from a cracked leather belt.
cast.portrait: Background: the hollow linden in the green forest clearing.

cast.name: Den unge kongen
cast.description: Enkesønnen på bryllupsmorgenen, med prinsessa og halve riket. Han vil gi den svarte hesten alt den ønsker seg, men ikke det den ber om.
cast.look: A slim young man of about twenty with milk-pale skin, bright red cheeks, an oval face, a neat, narrow nose, big dark-brown eyes under thick level black eyebrows and short, glossy blue-black hair, wavy on top, with a cowlick at the crown, dressed for his wedding in a slim cornflower-blue suit, a crisp white shirt, a narrow dark-red tie, a small gold crown pin on the lapel and polished brown shoes.
cast.portrait: Background: the stable of the royal estate on the wedding morning.

cast.name: Den svarte hesten (den forheksede prinsen)
cast.description: En svart hest med menneskeøyne som står bundet i trollets hus, snakker, hjelper gutten å flykte og vinne krigen, og til slutt ber om å bli satt fri fra trolldommen.
cast.look: A big, powerful, coal-black horse with a glossy coat and no white markings at all, a long, thick, wavy mane and tail, a long forelock falling between his eyes, a proudly arched neck, a broad forehead, soft velvety nostrils, strangely human, clever amber-brown eyes, very expressive ears and shaggy black feathering over his big round hooves. He wears a plain, worn brown leather halter.
cast.portrait: Background: the plank stable built inside the half-renovated house.

cast.name: Trollet i den mørke bilen
cast.description: Et troll i menneskeskikkelse, rolig og høflig i mørk frakk, som plukker opp gutten langs veien, forbyr ham fire dører i et halvferdig hus i granskogen og straffer ulydighet hardt.
cast.look: An unusually tall, gaunt man who almost looks human: a long, craggy face with a stony grey complexion, a huge knobbly nose, small glinting black eyes that almost never blink under bushy iron-grey eyebrows, a wide, thin-lipped mouth set in a polite smile, big pointed ears and a short, bristly iron-grey beard. He has very long arms, huge knobbly hands and enormous flat feet in big black leather shoes, and wears a long black wool overcoat with large horn buttons, even indoors, over a dark-grey suit and a black roll-neck.
cast.portrait: Background: the half-renovated hallway with ladders, paint buckets and four close-set doors.

cast.name: Prinsessa
cast.description: Kongens datter, selvstendig og kvikk i joggesko, som ser gutten under lavparykken og holder fast på ham selv når hun får husarrest og mister telefonen.
cast.look: A lively, quick-witted young woman of twenty-three with a round, dimpled face, a small nose, bright hazel eyes, fair rosy skin and two long, heavy dark-brown plaits tied with rose-pink hair elastics. She wears a loose rose-pink knitted jumper, wide light-blue jeans, chunky white trainers with pink laces and a slim silver necklace with a small pink stone.
cast.portrait: Background: her bedroom window at the royal estate, at sunrise.

cast.name: Kongen
cast.description: En streng og mektig konge i mørk dress med hvitt lommetørkle i brystlomma, som styrer kongsgården med kameraer og væpnede vakter og til slutt kjenner igjen sitt eget lommetørkle.
cast.look: A broad, barrel-chested man in his fifties with a square, stern face, a big hooked nose, deep-set dark eyes under heavy black eyebrows and a thick, bushy black beard streaked with grey. He wears a dark bottle-green three-piece suit, a white shirt and a dark tie, a heavy gold signet ring, polished black shoes and, in his breast pocket, a crisp white handkerchief with a small crown embroidered in one corner.
cast.portrait: Background: the glass-and-stone royal estate with a security camera on the corner.

places.name: the Royal Estate
places.look: A modern royal estate of glass and pale stone on a green slope above a bog and spruce forest: long, low wings with huge windows, clipped hedges, flower beds and a wide gravel driveway between two tall stone gateposts, each topped by a small black security camera, with another camera on every corner of the house. In the garden stands a tall, round glass summerhouse on steel posts with a spiral staircase. Behind a row of garages rises an old, round grey stone tower with one barred window.

cover.prompt: The Rusty Knight gallops towards the viewer on the Black Horse down a gravel road through dense, dark spruce forest at sunrise, visor pushed up and a fierce grin on his face, the horse's long black mane streaming. A grey boulder, an old tin canteen, a braided whip of thorny rose twigs and a small blue jar are tied to the saddle. The trees blur into green streaks on both sides.
cover.caption: Enkesønnen rir av sted på den svarte hesten.
cover.alt: En ung mann i rusten rustning galopperer mot oss på en stor, svart hest gjennom en mørk granskog. Ved salen henger en stein, en feltflaske og en tornepisk.

illustrations.anchor: Enkesønnen hadde ikke råd til bussen, så han gikk.
illustrations.prompt: On the gravel shoulder of an empty national road running into dense spruce forest, the Widow's Son has stopped walking, his small shoulder bag across his chest and the last petrol station far behind him. Beside him a long, dark car has slowed to a crawl and its side window has slid down; hunched at the wheel, the Stranger leans across with a polite smile and unblinking eyes. The boy bends to look in, tired and wary. Grey late afternoon.
illustrations.caption: Da han hadde gått i en dags tid, saktnet en mørk bil ned ved siden av ham.
illustrations.alt: Enkesønnen står ved en riksvei inn i granskogen med skulderveska si. En mørk bil har stoppet ved siden av ham, og bak rattet sitter en høy, grå mann og smiler.

illustrations.anchor: En dag sa han: «Nå reiser jeg bort i åtte dager.
illustrations.prompt: In the long hallway of the half-renovated house, with paint buckets, a stepladder and rolls of plastic along the walls, the Stranger stands in his long black overcoat with his car keys in one huge hand and nods calmly towards four plain doors set close together at the far end. He is smiling and does not blink. The Widow's Son stands beside him with his hands in his hoodie pocket, looking at the doors.
illustrations.caption: «Men du får ikke gå inn i noen av disse fire rommene.»
illustrations.alt: Den høye mannen i lang, svart frakk står i en halvferdig gang med malingsspann og stiger og nikker mot fire dører. Gutten står ved siden av og ser på dørene.

illustrations.anchor: Gutten gråt og ba for seg, og til slutt slapp han med livet.
illustrations.prompt: Morning in the half-renovated kitchen: bare plasterboard walls, a brand-new cooker and plastic sheeting over the window. The Stranger, still in his long black overcoat, stands at the cooker frying eggs in a pan and smiles pleasantly over his shoulder. The Widow's Son sits very stiffly at a small table with an empty plate and a fork in front of him, hunched and wary, watching him.
illustrations.caption: Neste morgen stekte mannen egg til ham.
illustrations.alt: Mannen i lang, svart frakk står ved komfyren og steker egg og smiler. Gutten sitter stivt ved et lite bord med en tom tallerken og følger med på ham.

illustrations.anchor: Det gikk akkurat som forrige gang, bare at nå holdt gutten seg unna i åtte dager.
illustrations.prompt: A nearly empty room in the half-renovated house, with bare floorboards and plastic sheeting over the window. On a narrow shelf above the door lie a grey boulder the size of a loaf of bread and an old, dented tin army canteen. The Widow's Son stands below with his head tipped back and one eyebrow raised, looking up at them with a sceptical, unimpressed face.
illustrations.caption: Det var sannelig noe å være så redd for, det også, tenkte gutten.
illustrations.alt: Gutten står i et nesten tomt rom og ser opp på en hylle over døra. Der ligger en grå kampestein på størrelse med et brød og en gammel feltflaske av blikk.

illustrations.anchor: Da han dro den opp igjen, var den forgylt.
illustrations.prompt: In a bare room, the Widow's Son kneels at an open trapdoor in the floorboards. Below, a huge round copper cauldron bubbles and steams, with no hotplate, no flame and no cable anywhere beneath it. He holds up his hand and stares at it: the finger he has just dipped in is gilded all over and shines in the gloom. Steam curls up past his astonished face.
illustrations.caption: Da han dro den opp igjen, var den forgylt.
illustrations.alt: Gutten kneler ved en åpen lem i gulvet. Der nede koker en stor kobberkjele uten noe under, og gutten stirrer på fingeren sin, som er blitt forgylt.

illustrations.anchor: Hesten snudde hodet og så på ham.
illustrations.prompt: Night, behind the fourth door: someone has built a stable inside the house, with plank walls, straw on the floor and a window of dirty panes letting in pale moonlight. The Black Horse stands tied with a rope, a hay net now hanging at his head, while a trough of glowing embers lies shoved aside with the last sparks still drifting. The horse has turned his head and looks at the Widow's Son with strangely human eyes. The boy, one gilded finger gleaming, stares back.
illustrations.caption: Hesten snudde hodet og så på ham. Den hadde øyne som et menneske.
illustrations.alt: En stor, svart hest står bundet i en stall inne i huset og ser på gutten med menneskeøyne. Høynettet henger ved hodet, og trauet med glør er skjøvet unna.

illustrations.anchor: Rommet ovenpå var som en herreekvipering fra en annen tid.
illustrations.prompt: The room upstairs looks like an old gentlemen's outfitters from another age: rows of suits of armour on stands along the walls, some polished to a mirror shine. In the middle, the Widow's Son heaves the rustiest suit of all onto his shoulder, with a rust-spotted sword under one arm and a saddle of cracked leather at his feet, puffing with the weight. Grey light falls through a plastic-covered window.
illustrations.caption: Han tok den mest rustne rustningen han fant.
illustrations.alt: I et rom fullt av rustninger på stativer, noen skinnende blanke, løfter gutten den mest rustne rustningen opp på skulderen. Ved føttene ligger et flekkete sverd og en sprukket sal.

illustrations.anchor: Det klarte han.
illustrations.prompt: In the plank stable, the Widow's Son, just out of the copper cauldron and back in his jeans and hoodie, his wet black hair dripping and his cheeks glowing red, lifts the Black Horse clean off the straw with both arms under its belly. The horse's four hooves dangle above the floor, and the Black Horse looks down at him, calm and approving. The rusty armour, the sword and the saddle lie ready in the straw.
illustrations.caption: «Prøv å løfte meg.» Det klarte han.
illustrations.alt: Gutten har vått hår og røde kinn og løfter den store, svarte hesten opp fra halmen. Rustningen, sverdet og salen ligger klare på gulvet.

illustrations.anchor: Gutten kastet, og i det samme vokste det opp et digert, tett nypekratt bak dem.
illustrations.prompt: On a gravel forest road, the Rusty Knight gallops away on the saddled Black Horse, twisting round with his visor up, having just flung something back over his shoulder. A boulder, a tin canteen and a small blue jar are tied to the saddle. Behind them a huge, dense thicket of wild roses has shot up across the road, higher than a house and bristling with thorns. On the far side, the Stranger in his black overcoat and about twenty grey-faced trolls in dark clothes have been stopped short, glaring.
illustrations.caption: I det samme vokste det opp et digert, tett nypekratt bak dem.
illustrations.alt: Gutten i rusten rustning galopperer av sted på den svarte hesten. Bak dem har det vokst opp et digert nypekratt, og på den andre siden må trollet og følget hans stanse.

illustrations.anchor: Gutten gjorde det, men hvordan det nå gikk til, kom han til å søle noen dråper på lenden til hesten.
illustrations.prompt: A great new lake lies grey and still under a drizzly sky, ringed by spruce forest. On the near shore stands the Black Horse, dripping from its swim, with the Rusty Knight in the saddle looking back. Along the far shore, a whole army of trolls glinting in shiny helmets and armour lies on their bellies in a long row with their faces in the water, drinking; their bellies swell like barrels. The Stranger lies at the front of the row, his black overcoat spread around him.
illustrations.caption: Trollene la seg ned på magen for å drikke vannet tomt.
illustrations.alt: Den svarte hesten står drivvåt på stranda med gutten i salen. På den andre siden av vannet ligger en lang rekke blanke troll på magen og drikker, og magene deres svulmer.

illustrations.anchor: Kongsgården var bygd av glass og stein, med klipte hekker og blomsterbed og et kamera på hvert hjørne.
illustrations.prompt: The Garden Boy, in his shaggy grey lichen wig, trudges up the wide gravel driveway towards the Royal Estate, all glass and pale stone behind clipped hedges and flower beds. On top of the two stone gateposts behind him, the small black security cameras have both swivelled round to follow him. Cool, bright morning light.
illustrations.caption: Kameraene på portstolpene snudde seg etter ham.
illustrations.alt: Gutten i lavparykken går oppover oppkjørselen mot en stor kongsgård av glass og stein. Kameraene på portstolpene har snudd seg etter ham.

illustrations.anchor: «Ja ja», sa gartneren til slutt og rakte ham en greip.
illustrations.prompt: In the garden of the Royal Estate, an old gardener with a grey beard and a green work vest stands with one hand on a wheelbarrow and holds out a garden fork to the Garden Boy. Behind the gardener, four members of the garden crew in green work clothes stare at the lichen wig with open disgust, and one young woman wrinkles her nose hard. The tall glass summerhouse rises in the background.
illustrations.caption: «Ja ja», sa gartneren til slutt og rakte ham en greip.
illustrations.alt: En gammel gartner med grått skjegg rekker gutten i lavparykken en greip. Bak ham står resten av hagelaget og rynker på nesen.

illustrations.anchor: Prinsessa sto i vinduet sitt og så ham.
illustrations.prompt: Sunrise at the Royal Estate. At an outdoor water post at the foot of the tall glass summerhouse, the Widow's Son splashes water on his face, his lichen wig hanging on the tap; the low sun lights up his glossy black hair and glowing cheeks. High up at a big window of the main house, the Princess, who has not slept, stands with her arms wrapped round herself and gazes down at him.
illustrations.caption: Uten parykken var han så pen at det var en lyst å se på ham.
illustrations.alt: Gutten vasker seg ved vannposten i soloppgangen, og lavparykken henger på kranen. Oppe i et vindu står prinsessa og ser ned på ham.

illustrations.anchor: Prinsessa ga venninna et nikk til, og denne gangen fikk hun nappet parykken av.
illustrations.prompt: At night in the Princess's bedroom, lit by a small bedside lamp, the Widow's Son lies on the floor just inside the door with his eyes shut, pretending to snore. The Princess's friend, a young woman with a short blonde bob in grey pyjamas, crouches beside him and holds up his shaggy lichen wig, revealing his glossy black hair and handsome face. The Princess sits on the edge of her bed with a hand over her mouth, delighted.
illustrations.caption: Denne gangen fikk hun nappet parykken av.
illustrations.alt: Gutten ligger innenfor døra og later som han sover. Venninna til prinsessa holder opp lavparykken, og prinsessa sitter på senga og holder seg for munnen av glede.

illustrations.anchor: Gutten fikk høre det av vakta som kom med maten.
illustrations.prompt: Inside a bare cell at the top of the old stone tower behind the garages. Through the barred window, the driveway of the Royal Estate is packed with dark cars, and a squad of uniformed guards drills on the lawn. The Garden Boy turns from the window to speak urgently to a young guard in a dark uniform, who has just brought in a tray of food and stares at him in disbelief.
illustrations.caption: «Gå til kongen for meg», sa han.
illustrations.alt: Gutten i lavparykken står i tårncella og snakker med en vakt som kommer med mat. Gjennom sprinklene ser vi mørke biler i oppkjørselen og vakter som øver på plenen.

illustrations.anchor: Da gutten kom fram, var slaget alt i gang, og kongen var i stor knipe.
illustrations.prompt: On a muddy slope at the edge of the spruce forest, the King crouches behind a black car with three of his guards, grim and hard-pressed. Down the hillside thunders the Rusty Knight on the Black Horse, visor down and rust flaking from his armour, and the enemy soldiers in grey-green combat gear break and run back towards the trees. The King half rises, staring after the rider.
illustrations.caption: Før noen skjønte hva de så, hadde han jaget fienden langt tilbake.
illustrations.alt: En rytter i rusten rustning kommer galopperende ned lia på en svart hest, og fiendene flykter mot skogen. Kongen sitter i dekning bak en bil og stirrer etter ham.

illustrations.anchor: «Knyt det rundt», sa han, «og hold opp med det hylet.»
illustrations.prompt: Evening at the edge of a wide, rust-brown bog. The Garden Boy, in a dented old helmet and a padded vest two sizes too big, sits stuck in the mud on an old quad bike with only three wheels on the ground and the fourth dragging, a spade strapped on the back. He clutches his calf and howls. From the back window of a passing black car, the King, looking fed up, tosses out his white handkerchief with the little embroidered crown.
illustrations.caption: «Knyt det rundt», sa han, «og hold opp med det hylet.»
illustrations.alt: Gutten sitter fast i myra på en gammel firehjuling, med bulkete hjelm og altfor stor vest, og holder seg til leggen. Fra et bilvindu kaster kongen et hvitt lommetørkle til ham.

illustrations.anchor: Gutten satt der han pleide, halvveis nede i gjørma ved siden av firehjulingen
illustrations.prompt: Dusk at the bog. A line of dark cars has stopped on the road with their doors open, and the King and his guards stand at the edge of the mud in silence; nobody laughs. In front of them, the Garden Boy sits half sunk in the mud beside his old quad bike in his dented helmet, holding his calf, where the white handkerchief with the little embroidered crown is tied. At the back, one guard studies the edge of the forest. The King stares at the handkerchief.
illustrations.caption: Kongens menn gikk ut av bilene og ble stående. Ingen lo.
illustrations.alt: Bilene har stoppet ved myra, og kongen og vaktene står stille. Gutten sitter i gjørma ved firehjulingen med kongens hvite lommetørkle knyttet rundt leggen.

illustrations.anchor: Så fikk han prinsessa.
illustrations.prompt: On the stone terrace of the Royal Estate on a bright evening, the Widow's Son, washed and without his wig, has just opened his mouth to ask the Princess something, one hand half raised. But she has already flung her arms round his neck and is laughing her answer. Behind them the big windows glow gold in the low sun.
illustrations.caption: Hun sa ja før han rakk å spørre.
illustrations.alt: På terrassen på kongsgården har gutten så vidt åpnet munnen for å spørre, men prinsessa har allerede kastet armene rundt halsen hans og ler.

illustrations.anchor: Så måtte han gjøre det.
illustrations.prompt: In the stable of the royal estate, soft morning light falls through a high window onto the straw of the best box. Where the black horse stood a moment ago, a young man now stands behind the half-door of the box, which hides him from the waist down: tall and broad-shouldered, with a long, proud face, amber-brown eyes, a short black beard and long, straight jet-black hair tied at the nape. The Young King, in his white shirt, holds out his cornflower-blue suit jacket to him, eyes wide with astonishment; his sword lies in the straw.
illustrations.caption: Der hesten hadde stått, sto det en prins.
illustrations.alt: I stallen står en ung, svarthåret prins bak halvdøra der hesten sto. Den unge kongen rekker ham dressjakka si og stirrer forbauset på ham.
